content: तमालः .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a tree with a very dark bark; तरुणतमालनीलबहलोन्नमदम्बुधराः <ls>Māl. 9. 18</ls>; <ls>R. 13. 15</ls>, <ls n="R. 13.">49</ls>; <ls>Gīt. 11</ls>. .²2 A sectarial mark of sandal upon the forehead made with the juice of the Tamāla fruit. .²3 A sword, scimitar. .²4 The bark of the bamboo. .²4 Tobacco.
